    • receiveTimerDTO

      public void receiveTimerDTO(TimerDTO timerDTO)
      Description copied from interface: ClientUI
      Method used to update the TimerDTO when either a player flips the timer or when the previous timer runs out and there's the need to notify all players about the status of the timer.
      This method is used exclusively during the ShipConstruction phase since it's the only place where the timer is relevant for the game.
      Specified by:
      receiveTimerDTO in interface ClientUI
      Overrides:
      receiveTimerDTO in class Screen
      Parameters:
      timerDTO - The TimerDTO received by the client from the server
